runtimeTraceability.note: Existing identity/catalog slice evidence is not full upstream UI E2E acceptance. Populate records only with actual observed workflow evidence.

localStartupAcceptance: Six apps use explicit local backend configuration
API, worker, PostgreSQL and Redis processes verified
Per-app health/connectivity verified separately from business E2E
Startup evidence records commands, ports, failures and process ownership
Stop the managed API as well as Next dev servers before aggregate tests: foundation harness owns4100; otherwise readiness can accidentally probe the live development API.
completionRule: Every applicable reachable action and workflow requires actual evidence and independent approval; missing external inputs remain blockers. Static inventories, smoke checks and Expo exports are not completeness evidence.
